requests: Whether two electric baseboard heaters can be stacked vertically, one about 12 inches above the other
Whether the second 5' heater must instead go in a different spot on the living room wall
reason: The reply says stacking will not work well and explains why: convection draws cool air in at the bottom and releases heated air at the top, so a stacked unit disrupts the flow. Instead of placing a second heater elsewhere, it suggests a single 5' heater with the same kW as the old 10' unit. This settles the either/or question, and it adds a mini-split suggestion.
label: Fully answered
